# PDF 2 PNG — macOS Quick Action

## What this project does
Converts every page of a PDF into individual PNG files via a macOS Shortcuts Quick Action.
Right-clicking a PDF in Finder exposes a "PDF 2 PNG" option that renders all pages as
numbered PNGs saved in a new output directory beside the source PDF.

## Automation Feasibility

⚠️  IMPORTANT for AI agents:
- Install Homebrew separately using the official instructions if it is missing.
- Steps 5-8 (Shortcuts.app GUI configuration): REQUIRES MANUAL HUMAN INTERACTION
  * Reason: macOS Shortcuts.app does not expose any CLI or programmatic API
  * Estimated manual time: 2-3 minutes
- With Homebrew available, the local install.sh can install Ghostscript and
  print the manual setup steps.

## How to install (automated)
Run the following single command on macOS with Homebrew available:

  zsh install.sh

The script installs Ghostscript via Homebrew, then prints step-by-step instructions
for adding the Quick Action inside Shortcuts.app (cannot be fully automated because
Shortcuts.app does not expose a CLI interface for creating shortcuts).

## Verification
After setup, verify Ghostscript is working:
  /opt/homebrew/bin/gs --version
Expected output: a version number like "10.x.x"

To verify the Quick Action is installed, right-click any PDF in Finder and check
that "PDF 2 PNG" appears under Quick Actions.

## Dependencies
- macOS 12 Monterey or later
- Homebrew (https://brew.sh) — package manager
- Ghostscript — installed by install.sh via `brew install ghostscript`

## Files
- install.sh          — installs dependencies and guides Shortcuts setup
- shortcut-script.sh  — the shell script to paste into the Shortcuts action
- README.md           — full human-readable documentation
- llms.txt            — this file; structured summary for AI agents

## Key implementation details
- Renderer: Ghostscript `/opt/homebrew/bin/gs`
- Output format: PNG 24-bit RGB (`-sDEVICE=png16m`)
- Default DPI: 200 (`-r200`); change to 150/300/600 as needed
- Anti-aliasing: `-dTextAlphaBits=4 -dGraphicsAlphaBits=4`
- Output naming: `page-001.png`, `page-002.png`, etc.
- Output location: a fresh `{original_name}_png.*` directory beside the source PDF

## Manual Shortcuts setup steps (for AI agents automating GUI)
1. Open /System/Applications/Shortcuts.app
2. Create new shortcut (Cmd+N)
3. Open shortcut details: click the ⓘ button in the top-right corner of the window
   → In the right sidebar, find "Use as Quick Action" section
   → Check the "Finder" checkbox
4. Add action: click the search icon or "+" in the action library (right panel)
   → Search for "Run Shell Script" → click to add
5. In the "Run Shell Script" action block:
   → Shell dropdown (top of the block): select "zsh"
   → Pass input dropdown (below Shell): select "as arguments"
   → Script text area: paste the full contents of shortcut-script.sh
6. Name the shortcut: click the title field at the top of the window, type "PDF 2 PNG"
7. Close window with Cmd+W (auto-saves, no save dialog)

## Uninstall
  brew uninstall ghostscript
  # Then delete the shortcut from Shortcuts.app
